hypotheses.justification: hdV becomes an argument only through `include hdV hj h₂ h₃ h₅ in`. The statement does not mention it: adjO DV σV q d (line 546), jO j w (line 516), ιO ι w (line 486), diag, and detV DV σV q d (line 553) are plain 𝒪-linear maps that do not take hdV. The scoped instances that do take hdV (instTowerP/instTowerP') are not involved. The proof does not use it either. It rewrites with jO_ιO, which is included only with hj h₂ h₃ h₅ (line 664), and then uses adjO_apply, diag_apply and detV_apply (all rfl lemmas) and T_Dv DV σV d (line 557, no include; it only uses DV.comm), finishing with simp and module. Mathematically, with p = (v₁, v₂), jO(ιO p) = ((q+1)v₁ + T·Dv v₂, T·Dv v₁ + (q+1)·Dv v₂). Applying adjO and commuting T past Dv gives (q+1)²·Dv vᵢ − T·Dv·T·Dv vᵢ in each component, which is detV vᵢ. No invertibility of Dv is needed. So the same proof should work once hdV is removed from the include.
